scanning real space headlines on the Wire with my brass dish
entries.why: I want to see what the deep space net has on orbit tracking.

His obsession with space tech has faded.
He's become a bit obsessed with space tech.

sweeping the outer rim with my brass dish, looking for echoes
entries.why: i want to catch a fast-moving comet or a lost freighter on my dish before my shift ends.
